tile_index_fix_confirmed.fix: let tile_col: u32 = gid(0u32) / 32u32;  // was: gid(0u32)
tile_index_fix_confirmed.tile_row: let tile_row: u32 = gid(1u32);  // UNCHANGED — local_size.y=1, no division
tile_index_fix_confirmed.asymmetry: CONFIRMED ASYMMETRIC — divide x by 32 (local_size.x=32); do NOT divide y (local_size.y=1). Derivation: @workgroup(32,1,1) + dispatch (N/16,M/16,1): gid(0)=wx*32+lx so gid(0)/32=wx=tile_col; gid(1)=wy*1+0=wy=tile_row. All 32 lanes of a workgroup compute tile_col=(wx*32+lane)/32==wx since lane<32. NOT symmetrized with the matmul_shared_f32.axc pattern (@workgroup(16,16,1) divides BOTH axes by 16 — that is a DISTRACTOR; not copied here).
